此版本为原生架构重建前最后一个版本。
This is the final release before the native architecture rebuild.

### RC3 Updates | RC3 更新

- 音频编码可选无损 PCM、AC3 与 E-AC3（`设置 → 音频与麦克风 → 音频编码`，需要 Foundation Sunshine）。主机不支持或声道布局超过 5.1 时回退到 Opus，并说明原因。
  Added lossless PCM, AC3, and E-AC3 audio (`Settings → Audio & Microphone → Audio Codec`, Foundation Sunshine required). Unsupported hosts and layouts above 5.1 fall back to Opus with a stated reason.
- AC3 / E-AC3 可原样直通给支持的输出设备（如 HDMI 功放或电视），也可在本机解码。直通失败或中途更换设备时自动改为本机解码，串流不中断。
  AC3 and E-AC3 can be passed through to capable output devices such as HDMI receivers and TVs, or decoded on the Mac. A failed passthrough or a device change falls back to local decoding without ending the stream.
- 控制中心可直接切换音频输出设备，音量滑块拖动更顺滑。新增“静音时保持音频流”，避免安静一段时间后第一声被截断；输出设备未能启动时串流继续运行。
  The control center can switch the audio output device, and its volume slider is smoother. A new “Keep Audio Stream Active During Silence” option prevents the first sound after silence from being cut off, and the stream keeps running when an output device fails to start.
- 新增精确式触控板：把 Mac 触控板的手指触点交给 Windows，使用 Windows 自己的手势与滚动。提供“屏蔽 macOS 触控板指针事件”和“同时使用”两种方式；授予辅助功能权限后可在串流期间屏蔽 macOS 系统手势。DualSense 触控板也可以这样使用。
  Added Precision Touchpad: the Mac trackpad's contacts are sent to Windows, which applies its own gestures and scrolling. It can either block macOS pointer events or work alongside them, and with Accessibility permission macOS system gestures are suppressed during a stream. The DualSense touchpad can be used the same way.
- 新增“使用 macOS 输入法输入文字”：拼音等输入法在本机完成组字，确认后的文字直接发送到主机。
  Added “Type Text with the macOS Input Method”: composition happens on the Mac and the committed text is sent to the host.
- 按键映射新增“输入的字符”方式，适合 Dvorak、Colemak 等布局；补齐 ISO 与 JIS 键盘的额外按键，并修正 Apple ISO 键盘上位置互换的两个键。
  Added a “Typed characters” key mapping mode for layouts such as Dvorak and Colemak, mapped the extra ISO and JIS keys, and corrected the two keys that Apple ISO keyboards swap.
- 可以用手柄操作应用：浏览应用列表和设置、打开菜单、调整滑块与选择器、用屏幕键盘输入，并在串流中打开控制中心。新增可自定义的手柄快捷键，包括触控板快捷键。
  The app can be driven with a controller: browse the app list and settings, open menus, adjust sliders and pickers, type with an on-screen keyboard, and open the control center during a stream. Added configurable controller shortcuts, including touchpad shortcuts.
- 所选的主机控制器类型（Xbox 360、DualShock 4、DualSense）会在启动和恢复串流时告知主机。修正陀螺仪与加速度的方向、单位和上报频率；窗口失去焦点时不再让游戏持续转向。
  The chosen host controller type (Xbox 360, DualShock 4, DualSense) is now declared to the host on launch and resume. Corrected the axes, units, and report rate of gyro and accelerometer data, and stopped games from continuing to turn after the window loses focus.
- 配合 Foundation Sunshine，串流中调整码率、帧率和分辨率不再需要重新连接。新增自适应码率与串流前带宽探测（默认关闭），以及视频 FEC 偏好。
  With Foundation Sunshine, bitrate, frame rate, and resolution can change during a stream without reconnecting. Added adaptive bitrate with a pre-stream bandwidth probe (off by default) and a video FEC preference.
- 缩短开始串流的等待：在主机启动应用的同时建立连接，加载动画在首帧到达时消失；串流期间保持完整的调度优先级。
  Shortened stream startup by building the connection while the host launches the app and clearing the loading indicator on the first frame; streams keep full scheduling priority while running.
- 控制中心可在串流期间调整主机显示缩放，并可运行主机为当前应用配置的主机命令；主机右键菜单新增“休眠主机”。客户端不会在开始串流时改动主机的缩放。
  The control center can change the host display scale during a stream and run the Host Commands configured for the current app; the host context menu gains “Sleep Host”. The client never changes the host's scale when a stream starts.
- HDR：新增“动态 HDR 偏好”（自动、Dolby Vision、HDR10+、仅 HDR10），性能浮窗显示实际协商的格式与回退原因；主机中途开关 HDR 时画面随之切换，并自动上报显示器亮度。移除不可用的 HDR Vivid 选项，Dolby Vision 不再与 4:4:4 同时提供。
  HDR: added a Dynamic HDR Preference (Automatic, Dolby Vision, HDR10+, HDR10 only), with the negotiated format and fallback reason shown in the performance overlay. The picture follows the host when HDR is toggled mid-stream, and display luminance is reported automatically. Removed the unavailable HDR Vivid rows; Dolby Vision is no longer offered together with 4:4:4.
- 修正原生渲染器下 Dolby Vision 的起播，以及 Metal 渲染器 SDR 输出的色彩标记和 10-bit 范围计算。
  Fixed Dolby Vision startup on the Native renderer, and the colour tagging and 10-bit range math of SDR output on the Metal renderer.
- 修复断开串流时可能出现的崩溃。
  Fixed a crash that could occur when a stream was disconnected.
- 尝试修复 macOS 12 至 14.3 上开始串流时的崩溃：原生与兼容渲染器不再直接调用 macOS 14.4 起才提供的接口（[#26](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/26)）。
  Attempted to fix stream-start crashes on macOS 12 through 14.3: the Native and Compatibility renderers no longer call an interface that only exists from macOS 14.4 (#26).
- 设置搜索可跳转到具体选项并高亮显示；修复 macOS 12–14 上分辨率选择器无法使用的问题。
  Settings search now scrolls to the chosen option and highlights it; fixed the resolution pickers on macOS 12–14.
- 日志查看器在日志量大时不再卡顿，可在串流窗口内直接打开；默认视图中的日志均提供中英文说明，并修复日志模式与等级选择不生效的问题。
  The log viewer stays responsive with large logs and can be opened inside the stream window; entries in the default view are described in Chinese and English, and the log mode and level pickers now take effect.
- 关于与更新页完成本地化，应用菜单中的“检查更新”与后台检查接入原生更新流程（[#55](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/pull/55)）。
  Localized the About & Updates page and connected the app menu's “Check for Updates” item and background checks to the native update flow (PR #55).

### RC2 Updates | RC2 更新

- 修复日志查看器重构后的本地化回退：日志模式、等级、筛选、搜索和详情统一遵循应用内中英文选择，并补齐缺失翻译（[#30](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/30)、[#44](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/pull/44)）。
  Fixed log-viewer localization regressions; mode, level, filters, search, and detail views now follow the in-app language selection (#30, PR #44).
- 统一手柄 Menu / Options 的长按切换规则：持续按住约 2 秒触发，两条输入路径行为一致；HID 设备也无需松手后才切换（[#45](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/pull/45)）。
  Unified Menu / Options mode switching to a two-second hold across both input paths, including HID devices without waiting for release (PR #45).
- 修复按住 Menu 期间修改开关留下旧计时的问题；重新开启后需先松手再开始新手势，避免短按误触切换。
  Fixed stale hold state across setting changes; release is required before a new gesture can begin, preventing accidental switches.
- 关闭手柄鼠标模拟或切回手柄时，释放鼠标点击并恢复 A/B 与摇杆输入，避免按钮粘滞及多余 Menu 点击；DualSense 触控板模式保持独立。
  Released emulated mouse clicks and restored controller controls when leaving mouse mode, avoiding stuck buttons and unintended Menu taps while preserving independent DualSense touchpad modes.
- 补齐 README 中的 DualSense、Foundation 和诊断使用说明，并明确 HDR10+ 动态元数据在 macOS 呈现链路上的保留限制。
  Expanded permanent README guidance for DualSense, Foundation features, and diagnostics, and clarified HDR10+ metadata limitations on macOS.

### Highlights | 更新内容

- 重构 SwiftUI 设置界面，重新组织串流、显示、音频、键鼠、手柄和更新页面，设置搜索支持具体选项。
  Reorganized SwiftUI settings and added option-level search.
- 补充串流控制菜单、连接设置和诊断提示的中英文本地化（[#30](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/30)）。
  Expanded Chinese and English localization across streaming controls, connection settings, and diagnostics (#30).
- 改善局域网发现、本地网络权限声明与手动地址探测，首选连接地址不可用时继续检测其他已知地址（[#33](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/33)、[#35](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/35)）。
  Improved LAN discovery, permission declarations, and address probing when the preferred route is unavailable (#33, #35).
- 修复自由鼠标模式下，鼠标悬停或 Command-Tab 切换应用后串流窗口自动抢回焦点的问题；现在需要点击才能重新激活窗口（[#21](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/21)、[#40](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/40)）。
  Fixed background stream windows stealing focus in Free Mouse mode after pointer hover or Command-Tab (#21, #40).
- 修正单独 Command 键映射 Windows 键的处理，并改善 Ctrl、Shift 和快捷键翻译的释放状态（[#23](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/23)、[#37](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/37)）。
  Fixed standalone Command-to-Windows-key handling and improved modifier release during shortcut translation (#23, #37).
- 尝试修复锁定鼠标无法移动及控制菜单返回后失去响应的问题，调整鼠标捕获、窗口焦点与菜单之间的输入恢复处理（[#24](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/24)、[#49](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/49)）。
  Attempted to fix mouse movement and menu-return stalls by refining capture and recovery (#24, #49).
- 改善串流启动与原生解码处理，加入窗口内加载动画，修正 Metal 启动时的回调配置错误。
  Improved stream startup and native decoding, added an in-window loading indicator, and corrected Metal startup callback configuration.
- 尝试修复 macOS 12 串流启动崩溃，避免布局期间重复调整控件层级，并加入布局重入保护（[#26](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/26)）。
  Attempted to fix macOS 12 stream-start crashes with layout reentry protection (#26).
- 尝试修复部分手柄的映射与方向输入异常，完善手柄类型识别、映射诊断及输入暂停时的状态释放（[#25](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/25)）。DualSense 支持电量、动作、震动和灯光反馈，提供触控板透传与 Mac 风格模式，可长按 Options 切换。
  Attempted to fix controller mapping and directional input issues (#25), and expanded DualSense feedback and switchable touchpad modes.
- 调整 DualSense 触控板轻点、自然滚动、滚动轴锁定和松手处理，减少光标跳动。
  Refined DualSense tapping, natural scrolling, axis locking, and release handling.
- 新增独立的 10-bit SDR 设置与协商路径（[#22](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/22)）；尝试修复 HDR 泛白与过曝，调整色彩元数据、PQ/HLG 和画面比例处理（[#29](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/29)）。按所选渲染器显示适用设置。
  Added explicit 10-bit SDR negotiation (#22) and attempted to fix washed-out or overexposed HDR output (#29).
- 增加 Foundation 显示器和虚拟显示器配置，改善文本及图片剪贴板协议兼容性；已完成 Foundation 剪贴板互通验证（[#32](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/32)）。
  Added Foundation display configuration and improved clipboard compatibility, with text/image synchronization verified (#32).
- 增加性能诊断和报告导出，提供帧率、1% low、网络及帧呈现抖动、丢帧和音频欠载数据，尝试改善流畅度与统计异常（[#31](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/31)）。
  Improved native decoding and diagnostics to address smoothness and frame-statistics anomalies (#31).
- 接入 Sparkle 更新界面与测试版渠道。更新优先使用 GitHub，下载失败时尝试同版本的 CNB 镜像，并继续验证更新包签名。
  Integrated Sparkle and a beta channel, with GitHub-first downloads and an identical signed CNB archive fallback.
- 修正自定义分辨率输入及码率设置范围，使用独立应用身份以支持与 QT 版本共存（[#41](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/41)）。
  Corrected custom resolution and bitrate controls and isolated the app identity for coexistence with QT clients (#41).

- 尝试修复 DNF 中的方向键失灵，调整快捷键翻译与修饰键状态处理，避免错误吞键（[#39](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/39)）。
  Attempted to fix DNF arrow-key input by refining shortcut translation and modifier-state handling (#39).

### Release Candidate | 候选版本说明

- 可在 `设置 → 关于与更新` 检查更新；如果没有收到更新提示，请从发布页手动下载安装。
  Check for updates in `Settings → About & Updates`; if no update is offered, download and install this candidate manually from the release page.

- 这是预发布版本。欢迎通过对应 issue 反馈使用情况；仍然遇到同类问题时，请附上系统版本、主机版本、输入设备及日志。
  This is a prerelease. If an issue persists, include your OS, host version, input device, and logs in the corresponding report.
- Dolby Vision 8.1/8.4 与 HDR10+ 提供能力探测、适配和安全回退；最终输出受系统、硬件和显示链路影响。HDR Vivid 当前不可用。
  Dolby Vision 8.1/8.4 and HDR10+ provide capability probing, integration, and safe fallback. Output depends on the system, hardware, and display path. HDR Vivid is unavailable.
- USB 转发和主机文件为实验性能力，需要支持并启用对应功能的 Foundation Sunshine。主机文件为只读访问，Finder 挂载还需要支持相应 App Group 的签名版本。
  USB forwarding and Host Files are experimental and require the corresponding Foundation Sunshine features. Host Files is read-only; Finder mounting also requires a signed build supporting the required App Group.
